title.zh: Kling 4.0把单次视频拉到30秒，10月上线
title.en: Kling 4.0把单次视频拉到30秒，10月上线

current_state.zh: Kling 4.0已全量上线，支持单次30秒视频、最多10张关键帧、15项素材参考，并可通过MCP/CLI调用；10-bit HDR、最长2分钟续拍和开发者API仍未开放。
current_state.en: Kling 4.0 is now generally available with 30-second single-pass generation, up to 10 keyframes, 15-asset reference compositing and MCP/CLI access; 10-bit HDR, up to 2-minute extension and the developer API are still pending.

updates.title_zh: Kling 4.0把单次视频拉到30秒，10月上线
updates.title_en: Kling 4.0把单次视频拉到30秒，10月上线
updates.what_changed_zh: 快手Kling 4.0开启预览，支持原生30秒视频生成、10个关键帧控制、最多15个多模态参考输入、精细化视频编辑、立体声音频和多语言唇形同步，完整版和API将于10月推出。
updates.what_changed_en: Kuaishou's Kling 4.0 is previewed with native 30-second video generation, 10 keyframe controls, up to 15 multimodal reference inputs, refined video editing, stereo audio and multilingual lip-sync, with the full release and API coming in October.
updates.current_state_zh: 快手Kling 4.0开启预览，支持原生30秒视频生成、10个关键帧控制、最多15个多模态参考输入、精细化视频编辑、立体声音频和多语言唇形同步，完整版和API将于10月推出。
updates.current_state_en: Kuaishou's Kling 4.0 is previewed with native 30-second video generation, 10 keyframe controls, up to 15 multimodal reference inputs, refined video editing, stereo audio and multilingual lip-sync, with the full release and API coming in October.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Kuaishou's Kling 4.0 is previewed with native 30-second video generation, 10 keyframe controls, up to 15 multimodal reference inputs, refined video editing, stereo audio and multilingual lip-sync, with the full release and API coming in October.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Kuaishou's Kling 4.0 is previewed with native 30-second video generation, 10 keyframe controls, up to 15 multimodal reference inputs, refined video editing, stereo audio and multilingual lip-sync, with the full release and API coming in October.

updates.title_zh: 可灵4.0全量上线：30秒1080P视频约16元，4K HDR却还得等
updates.title_en: 可灵4.0全量上线：30秒1080P视频约16元，4K HDR却还得等
updates.what_changed_zh: Kling 4.0于10月15日全量上线（此前9月底仅有Flash向部分付费用户开放），30秒1080P生成约450积分/约16元，新增时间线、画布与Agent功能，并支持通过MCP、CLI调用；10-bit HDR、最长2分钟续拍和开发者API仍未上线。
updates.what_changed_en: Kling 4.0 fully rolled out on October 15 (after only a Flash preview for some paying users in late September): ~450 credits (~¥16) for a 30s 1080P clip, new timeline/canvas/Agent features and MCP/CLI access, while 10-bit HDR, up to 2-minute extension and the developer API remain unavailable.
updates.current_state_zh: Kling 4.0已全量上线，支持单次30秒视频、最多10张关键帧、15项素材参考，并可通过MCP/CLI调用；10-bit HDR、最长2分钟续拍和开发者API仍未开放。
updates.current_state_en: Kling 4.0 is now generally available with 30-second single-pass generation, up to 10 keyframes, 15-asset reference compositing and MCP/CLI access; 10-bit HDR, up to 2-minute extension and the developer API are still pending.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Kuaishou's Kling AI has fully rolled out Kling 4.0, doubling video generation to 30 seconds with up to 10 keyframes, 15-asset reference compositing and MCP/CLI agent access, at roughly ¥16 per 30s 1080P clip, while 10-bit HDR, longer extension and the developer API remain pending.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Kuaishou's Kling AI has fully rolled out Kling 4.0, doubling video generation to 30 seconds with up to 10 keyframes, 15-asset reference compositing and MCP/CLI agent access, at roughly ¥16 per 30s 1080P clip, while 10-bit HDR, longer extension and the developer API remain pending.
